annotations.title: He ſcourgeth.
annotations.text: <mn>◦</mn> By this we proue that God often puniſheth the ſinnes euen of his louing children, though not with eternal damnation, yet vvith temporall chaſtiſement and correction: & that he doth not alwaies together vvith the remiſſion of deadly ſinnes & eternal puniſhment, exempt the offender receiued to his grace, from al fatherly correction either in this life or in the next. Neither haue the Heretikes of this time any reaſon or ſcripture in the world, vvhy they ſhould take avvay Gods chaſtiſement of his children in the next life, more then in this world.

notes.text: Temporal punishment after remission of sinnes, either here, or in purgatorie.

annotations.title: He found not.
annotations.text: It is not meant, that Eſau could not find remiſſion of his ſinne at Gods hand: but that, hauing once ſold and yelded vp the right of his firſt-birth to his yonger brother, it vvas to late to be ſorie for his vnaduiſed bargaine.
